component.name: EMRAX 228 HV CC — 2020 contour bands

ratingProvenance.locator: PDF p.1 HV/CC table; p.2 continuous torque graph and p.3 cooling notes
ratingProvenance.continuousTorqueBasis: Conservative minimum of published CC continuous-torque curve, rather than assuming 120 Nm at every speed.
ratingProvenance.peakDutyBasis: 1 second explicitly adopted conservatively; source says few seconds for peak torque and 2 minutes for peak current. Not a manufacturer-guaranteed peak-torque duration.
ratingProvenance.limitingSpeedBasis: 5500 rpm sustained limit; optional 6500 rpm field weakening is excluded.

component.source: EMRAX 228 HV / combined cooled; 2020-03-05 manual 5.4, PDF pp.1–3

map.source: EMRAX 228 HV / combined cooled; 2020-03-05 manual 5.4, PDF pp.1–3

testConditions.cooling: combined: 20 m/s air, 25 C ambient; 8 L/min coolant at 50 C
testConditions.temperature: Winding and magnet absolute limit 120 C; actual map test temperature unreported

provenance.locator: 2020-03-05 edition 5.4, PDF page 2, lower EMRAX 228 CC motor efficiency chart; embedded Image20
provenance.method: Lower efficiency bound of the containing published contour band; loss = shaft power * (1 / lower_bound - 1). Strictly inside contour, two-pixel margin. Bilinear interpolation is derived and may cross contour bands; it is not a measured loss table.
provenance.regenPolicy: No negative-torque data; regeneration not supported, never reflected.
provenance.standbyPolicy: Zero torque and zero speed not mapped; no standby/copper-loss assumption fabricated.
limitations: Historical 2020 winding/cooling, not interchangeable with v1.7 ratings.
Conservative contour bands, not point measurements; no independent experimental validation.
No map voltage/temperature variation; inverter efficiency must be declared separately.
